Please be reminded of the correct process before scheduling a customer for a Hearing Specialist consultation.

We noticed that some Hearing Specialist appointments were being scheduled through the wrong event link, and some agents are also jumping straight to the consultation offer without first checking the customer’s return date and eligibility.

Before Scheduling a Consultation

Please make sure to:

1.Check the customer’s return eligibility/window first.
2.Review the customer’s previous consultation history and determine whether another consultation is actually needed.
3.If the customer is already outside the return window or has already met with the specialists, please focus on troubleshooting first instead of automatically scheduling another consultation.
4.Only offer a consultation when it is appropriate based on the customer’s concern and eligibility.


Important: 
A consultation should NOT be used as an automatic step for every OHA concern.
For example, in one recent case, the customer had already met with our specialists twice and was no longer eligible for a return. The appropriate handling would have been to conduct further troubleshooting rather than immediately scheduling another consultation.

Please be reminded to REFRAIN from using the same made-up email address for multiple customers who do not have an email address.

DO NOT
 use: na@na.com
Using the same email address for multiple customers can cause order processing errors. In Sticky, customers are tied to their email address, so if you try to update any customer information under a shared email, the information of other customers using that same email may also be changed. This can lead to incorrect customer details and order information.

 Moving forward:
If a customer says they do not have an email address and still wants to place an order, please create a unique made-up email address using the customer's name and phone number.

Example:

Customer Name: Merya Wolfe
Phone: 919-931-7453

Substitute Email: 
 meryawolfe919-931-7453@phonesalesnoemail.com
This ensures that each customer has a unique email address in the system and helps prevent customer information from being mixed up or accidentally updated.

:warning: Please make sure the made-up email is UNIQUE for every customer. Do not reuse the same email address for different customers.

Thank you, Team! :pray: Please make sure to follow this moving forward to avoid order processing issues.
